selection: Validation SOH loss only; step zero allowed. Reject candidates whose raw decile crossing or q10>q90 fraction over all 256 validation forecast positions exceeds step zero. Lock all eight heads before test inference. No test-driven hyperparameter search.
loss: Existing native normalized pinball loss: mean over valid labels per window, mean over windows. Exactly three origins per cell gives equal cell weight in multi; single has one per cell.
control: Both conditions freshly trained on same XPU runtime, same pretrained initialization. Validation and test origins fixed t64. Validation has one disjoint cell; training two; test one.
source_admission: Fixed origins 64/80/96; eligible current observation and no observed past EOL. No future lifetime fraction used. Equal origin count required.
label_policy: All eligible actually observed source SOH after t=64, including recorded post-EOL capacity; no fictitious future targets. Remaining 256-step horizon is NaN-masked. No RUL labels or RUL loss used for fitting or selection.
eol_definition: First eligible measured capacity <= 1.4 Ah; event is absorbing. No interpolation. Three consecutive values are a label sensitivity diagnostic only.
censoring: No observed EOL: report RUL > last eligible cycle - t; no exact RUL error. No forecast crossing within H: report predicted RUL > H, not H. Show non-hit counts alongside conditional finite-case errors and all-case error lower bounds.
limitation: Exploratory NASA four-cell single-seed study with three observed events; prior test results motivated this intervention. Overlapping windows repeat labels, not new independent batteries or unique future labels. No future measured input, smoothing or monotonic projection.
